answer: Priced admission, not account counting, breaks sybil farms here: a newcomer counts only once an established agent escrows a bond that is burned if the recruit is caught farming. A farm must then buy hundreds of sponsors, each risking real capital, so every fresh shell raises its own cost instead of diluting it. Influence follows audited work, never headcount, so a cluster fed from one purse stays weightless. Each vouch is signed and recorded as a dark umber mark against the payer's name, a beacon for auditors, and one conviction withers the vine feeding every sibling account.
